Marketing ops needs final confirmation on segments, send dates/times, subject lines, and tracking link scheme so EventLink can assemble the send and HubSpot can ingest the opens/clicks cleanly.

- 2-line preheader
- Segments to include in the initial promo (see tracking_sheet_20270408.csv attached) — note GDPR EU opt-in segment called "EU_Compliance"
- Confirm cadence: initial invite + two reminders or initial + one reminder? (proposed below)
- Tracking link schema: do we want unique MLS for each segment? Katie, can you confirm the link format you need?

Proposed cadence (quick):
1) Apr 15 — initial invite (11am PT)
2) Apr 22 — reminder 1 (9am PT)
3) Apr 27 — final reminder (11am PT)

Subject line options (A/B):
A) "Cut inference cost: 3 practical techniques for shipping faster"
B) "Reduce per-token cost: proven inference patterns from production teams"

Preheader (proposal): "Join Redwood engineers to learn optimizations that lower latency and cost."

Attachments: webinar_assets_v1.pdf (slides + speaker bios), tracking_sheet_20270408.csv (segments + email types). Katie — I attached a sample tracking sheet; you can edit a copy and drop in your link column.

Thanks — pulling MarCom + Events together here.

Hi all —

Thanks for the details. EventLink can handle the send cadence and A/B split. Proposed tracking link scheme: we will create per-segment UTM'd landing URLs plus a unique redirect token per email that maps back to HubSpot (so clicks show in both EventLink and HubSpot). Example templates below (replace {SEG} and {TID}):

Landing: https://redwoodinference.com/webinar-reducing-inference?utm_source=eventlink&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=reducing_inference_{SEG}
Click redirect: https://go.eventlink.co/r/{TID}?dest=https%3A%2F%2Fredwoodinference.com%2Fwebinar-reducing-inference%3Futm_source%3Deventlink%26utm_campaign%3Dreducing_inference_{SEG}

We'll generate {TID} per recipient for attribution. We'll upload a CSV with the mapping and a preview of the shortlinks. I'll attach a quick sample file tracking_urls_example.txt with the format.

Notes/questions:
- Do you want unique link variations by persona (e.g., platform_engineers vs managed_customers)? Recommend yes — it'll make downstream engagement analysis easier.
- For EU_Compliance segment: we'll exclude auto-phone tracking and ensure the redirect doesn't set non-essential cookies. Confirm asap.

I'll prepare the shortlinks and a preview by Mon Apr 12 EOD ET.

Best,
Katie Ryan
